It searches for the latest national policies, official speeches, and regulatory requirements relevant to the user's topic, then generates formal documents strictly following GB/T 9704-2020 standards with polished, professional writing. Triggers include: 写公文、写请示、写报告、汇报材料、公文写作、向上级汇报、撰写报告、撰写请示、生成公文、公文草拟、发言稿、致辞, or any request to create formal Chinese government/enterprise correspondence.
